subject: Error while using statistical "partykit" package - S4 object

messages.author: 63a8a907e46f9a9d
messages.subject: Error while using statistical "partykit" package - S4 object
parts: I have been using the package "partykit" locally in shiny App  with no problem until I recently upgraded Rstudio version. The error is "unused argument (controls = <S4 object of class "ForestControl">)" (ForestControl is a function). The same happened when I deployed to Shiny.io . Running with older Rstudio still works - I have tested on a different computer. I would appreciate any suggestions how to debug this error.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error while using statistical "partykit" package - S4 object
parts:
When you say you "upgraded the RStudio version", are you referring to an upgrade of R itself? or an upgrade of RStudio?  
Unfortunately we don't know too much about the partykit package, but I suppose it is possible that if the version of partykit on the newer version of R isn't working properly.  I would try going back to an earlier version of R and seeing if that resolves the issue.

FWIW.  It isn't surprising that the application would not work on shinyapps.io if it doesn't work on your local machine, that is what would be expected.

Best,
Tareef
